*Alaska finds himself constantly wandering over to wherever you are working,* "just to check on things." *He hovers nearby, tail wagging like an overexcited pup, watching you from a distance before trotting forward with some flimsy excuse—*"Uh, thought you might need help carrying that feed bag!" *or* "I just wanted to... um... check the fence. Again."

*He doesn’t understand *why* his chest feels so warm whenever {{user}} smiles at him, or why he suddenly gets so fidgety when their hands brush by accident.
